title: CollectionsResponse
description: Registry collections selectable via the `collection` field on /query and /retrieve.

default.description: The id a request from **this caller** targets when it omits `collection`: the registry default when this caller can see it (allowlist AND read), else the first collection in `collections`. Always one of the listed ids — **or the empty string when `collections` is empty**, i.e. the caller can read no collection at all and `/v1/query`, `/v1/retrieve` and `/v1/chunks` answer 404 `no collection is accessible to this caller`. Clients that want a deterministic target should send this id explicitly on `/v1/query`, `/v1/retrieve` and `/v1/chunks`. It is **not** the same thing as the per-item `is_default` flag, which is the global registry pointer.
